question: What attainments make a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together as attainments.
Great accomplishment is also named as an attainment.
These attainments lead to becoming dear to the yoginīs.
inference: One who possesses enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: Through enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment, one may become dear to the yoginīs.
